name: Grizzly Tech
source:
You play as a cynical older man who witnesses the advent of a nanotechnology breakthrough in medical research. 

Navigate through his life story up to his 'happy' ending, or maybe not? 

This was adapted to Ren'py from Gryphbear's original novel, "Grizzly Science", and the really early demo was made for participation of the Bara Jam 2018. 

[Edited from [url=https://gryphbear.itch.io/grizzly-science]itch.io[/url]]
